repos_data.description: The open-source agent firewall. Prevent AI agents from leaking data, using dangerous tools, and importing poisoned dependencies.
Agent governance for ThumbGate: 👍/👎 become Pre-Action Checks that block repeat mistakes before code, money, or customer systems change.

LLM guardrails & prompt injection detection for Python. Auto-instruments LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI, LiteLLM + 8 more frameworks. PII masking, toxicity detection, policy CI/CD. One line, zero code changes.
AI writes. SPARDA proves. A deterministic, offline gate that catches when an AI edit removes a guard, exposes a route, or breaks an invariant — no API key, right in the agent edit loop.
Your AI agent just burned $200. AgentGuard stops it at $5. Runtime cost guardrails for AI agents — budget enforcement, loop detection, kill switch. Zero dependencies, MIT licensed.
MCP server that adds a fail-closed quality gate and hash-chained receipt ledger to any AI agent workflow.
